Abhishek Shrivastava vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 26
February, 2026
 1 
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
 Mcrc No. 8873 of 2023
(Abhishek Shrivastava Vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others ) Dated :
26-02-2026 Shri Baboo Ji Chourasia - Advocate for the petitioner.
Shri Amit Pandey, Pl for State.

entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that S.T. No. 151/2023 is pending before the Court of the
8th Additional Sessions Judge, Jabalpur, for trial under Sections 376 and 376(2)(N) of the Ipc.
He further submits that the Sessions Trial was, for the first time, fixed for recording of evidence on 25.09.2023.
On the said date, the trial Court issued summons to the prosecutrix and also directed the prosecution to produce her for evidence.

However, despite being granted several opportunities,
approximately 18 in number, the prosecution has failed to produce the prosecutrix before the trial Court, as a result of which the matter is unnecessarily pending.
It is further submitted that the prosecutrix is not traceable.
In this regard, a letter dated 06.01.2026 issued by the SHO, Police Station Barela, Jabalpur, has been produced by learned counsel for the State.

On the reverse side of the said letter, a note is recorded stating that the husband of the prosecutrix informed that after the alleged incident, the prosecutrix is no longer residing at the given address and is presently living in Bhopal; however, he does not know her address or mobile number.

Learned counsel for the petitioner further submits that despite the lapse of three years, the prosecution has completely failed to produce the 2 MCRC-8873-2023 prosecutrix before the trial Court, and the trial is unnecessarily pending before the Sessions Court.
He also submitted that the husband of the prosecutrix has filed a divorce petition before the Family Court, Jabalpur.
The prosecutrix/wife has filed M.C.C. No. 202/2025 before the High Court at Jabalpur seeking transfer of the aforesaid divorce petition from Jabalpur to Bhopal.

Learned counsel for the State, as well as the Investigating Officer, are directed to verify and obtain the address of the prosecutrix from the aforesaid M.C.C. and the divorce petition pending before the Family Court, Jabalpur.

In view of the above, the SHO, Police Station Barela, Jabalpur, is directed to serve the summons already issued by the trial Court upon the prosecutrix and to secure her presence before the trial Court on 07.04.2026 positively, failing which he shall remain personally present before this Court on the next date of hearing.
